Description
Beautifully updated, unfurnished 2-story townhouse-style condo in sought-after Kitsilano. This bright, south-facing home features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a spacious laundry room and ample storage. Modern kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, gas stove and plenty of cabinetry. Open-concept living and dining area with a cozy gas fireplace. Enjoy a private, south-facing fenced yard and patio, perfect for outdoor dining and relaxing. Building amenities include a children's playroom, bike room and workshop. Steps to transit and close to UBC, Downtown, Bayview Elementary, parks, shops, cafes and restaurants.
